title: Matterbridge Enphase Envoy / IQ Gateway
description: Read-only Matter sensors for Enphase Envoy / IQ Gateway: solar production, grid consumption, battery and gateway status.

envoyIp.description: IP address or hostname of the Envoy / IQ Gateway on your local network

serialNumber.description: Envoy / IQ Gateway serial number (required to obtain an Enlighten token on firmware >= 7.0)

enlightenEmail.description: Enlighten cloud account email (firmware >= 7.0 token auth)

enlightenPassword.description: Enlighten cloud account password (firmware >= 7.0 token auth)

token.description: Optional pre-generated Enlighten JWT token (used instead of email/password)

installerUser.description: Firmware < 7.0: use the local installer account (no token required)

hasBattery.description: Expose a battery storage device (IQ Battery installed)

showInverters.description: Expose each micro-inverter as a child panel (duplicates the aggregate Solar Production reading)

unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
